project.contentDesc:
Slide 1: One bad day can end the business.
For a small fleet, one bad day can threaten the entire business. Operating costs and insurance pressure leave almost no room for a weak safety decision.

Slide 2: An AI dashcam is the smartest dollar.
An AI dashcam can be the smartest dollar a tight-budget fleet spends: evidence helps resolve the dispute, while AI helps reduce the next risk.

Slide 3: Too much to carry, or too little to trust.
The market still forces fleets between expensive enterprise subscriptions and cheap cameras that only record the loss. Neither choice fits the operator counting every dollar.

Slide 4: The Hidden Cost
The lowest purchase price can hide the highest operational cost. Evidence quality, dependable AI, protected power and fleet-ready connectivity all have to survive the real road.

Slide 5: Three Questions Before the Baseline
Before choosing the device, ask three questions: what is the true total cost, can compliance scale across markets, and can AI act before the next incident?

Slide 6: Meet DS100
Meet DS100.

Slide 7: DS100 — Product Film
Now let us see what the new baseline is made of.

Slide 8: Fleet Safety Accessible to All
DS100 establishes a new baseline with dual 2MP video, industrial-grade hardware and effortless deployment.

Slide 9: Designed for dependable daily operation.
Whichever version a fleet chooses, the evidence has to survive. DS100 combines protected storage, flexible connectivity and industrial-grade hardware for the moment that matters.

Slide 10: See the whole cabin. In any light.
Coverage sees the whole cabin in any light, with a 172-degree field of view, automatic infrared and digital WDR.

Slide 11: What's ahead. Wide enough to miss nothing.
Its wide road-facing view captures more context around the vehicle—especially cut-ins, intersections and incidents near the edge of frame.

Slide 12: GPS Dead Zone?
A GPS dead zone does not have to become a safety blind spot. Dead Reckoning carries speed and positioning continuity when GNSS drops out.

Slide 13: EzInstaller
EzInstaller guides the setup on the phone while two first-person installation views show the physical mount and cable connection. From windshield to ready, in minutes.

Slide 14: Every Face Pixelated. Every Frame Compliant.
DS100 supports a privacy-conscious workflow so shared footage can protect identity without giving up the operational record.

Slide 15: A Compliance Recorder That Protects the Driver, Too.
Coverage begins as a compliance recorder, but it also brings seven cabin-facing DSC functions into the entry-level safety program.

Slide 16: DS100 + FT Cloud
DS100 detects and alerts at the edge; FT Cloud brings event video to the fleet team for monitoring, review and coaching. Detect, alert, upload, review and coach—the loop stays connected.

[Sources]
Streamax DS100 Product Specification
Streamax DS100 User Manual

Slide 17: What if you want more?
Coverage establishes the baseline. Now the question is whether a fleet needs more prevention, more precision and more intelligence before impact.

Slide 18: What's ahead. Sharp enough to spot it early.
The Precision road-facing lens combines a focused 103-degree field of view, 3.85 millimeter focal length, F1.2 aperture and Digital WDR to pick out critical details farther ahead.

Slide 19: We Fit Every Safety AI This Chip Could Carry.
Precision combines road-facing ADAS with seven cabin-facing DSC functions—the focused safety AI an entry fleet needs to start a real program.

Slide 20: Coverage → Precision
Coverage comes first: a wider field keeps more road context in view. Then Precision concentrates the optical strategy to preserve more detail farther ahead. The video on this transition page is a replaceable placeholder asset.

Slide 21: Two lenses. One for your road.
Watch the lens strategy switch in real time. Precision narrows and reaches forward; Coverage opens the frame to capture more of what happens around the vehicle.

Slide 22: Choose the Outcome Your Fleet Needs First
Choose by the risk that matters first. Coverage protects the claim; Precision adds stronger prevention and coaching intelligence.

Slide 23: Fleet Safety Accessible to All
Fleet Safety Accessible to All. DS100 is the new baseline AI dashcam—focused on the protection fleets actually need.

Slide 24: From Safety Visibility to Business Confidence
DS100 helps fleets turn safety visibility into action. Connected events support faster response, dual-channel video strengthens incident review, and AI events with coaching records make safety management easier to verify.

Slide 25: One More Thing
One more thing.

Slide 26: Thank You & Q&A
Thank you. We welcome your questions.

globalDesign.palette: Use only Aurora tokens: --bg-deep and --bg-gradient for the canvas; --primary-green and --secondary-blue for emphasis; --text-white and --text-grey for copy; --glass-bg, --glass-border, and --card-bg for surfaces.
globalDesign.typography: Use var(--font-main) Inter for headings and body copy, with CJK fallbacks; use var(--font-mono) JetBrains Mono only for technical labels and numeric specifications. Preserve the original size hierarchy.
globalDesign.motionLanguage: Preserve each source page interaction and timing; MeetDeck canvas scaling is isolated in fitSlide. Future edits should use Aurora entrance families such as fadeUp, fadeUpCard, maskReveal, blurIn, and scaleIn.
globalDesign.decorationSystem: Preserve the existing dark industrial imagery, grid treatments, technical overlays, restrained glass surfaces, and product video framing; use only Aurora color tokens for future redraws.
globalDesign.rhythm: Maintain the final 28-slide sequence: launch title and agenda, business stakes, DS100 reveal and product film, Coverage proof, Precision transition and comparison, FT Cloud close-loop, product summary, business value close, One More Thing, and Q&A.
